note: Examine lines are unique game-wide, with these exceptions. Each one is a deliberate repetition that a dedupe pass would 'fix' and thereby delete a joke.

allow.reason: Doc 16, verbatim. The cards' first two LISTEN variants are both a flat 'Nothing.' -- the hand is abandoned and there is nobody to hear. Variant 3 resolves it. Same construction as the mud's identical variant.

Doc 16, verbatim. 'Nothing.' is Thad's standing answer to a silent object, and doc 16 uses it as a bare line for the portrait, the cards and the back room door. Three objects being silent in the same words is the joke; making them silent in three different ways would be writing around it.

Errata ruling 19a, verbatim. Variant 2 of the lamp after Hob has gone: 'Nothing. He has taken the sound with him too.' then 'Nothing.' then 'Nothing at all.' The bare middle line is the same standing answer to a silent object that doc 16 uses three times in the Nugget, and it is the falling-away that the sequence is for.

Doc 17 v2 note 3, explicit: THE ROAD EAST's LISTEN variants 2 and 3 are identical to each other AND to the line at the high ridge in Act IV. Three uses of the same two words, a hundred yards and fifteen hours apart. The doc says 'Do not vary them.'

Errata doc 19 section 2, verbatim. Variant 2 of the rewritten TWO LINES: 'Nothing. Two empty queues are quieter than one.' then 'Nothing.' then 'Nothing at all. There is a clock, and there is a man, and that is the whole of it.' The bare middle line is the same falling-away doc 16 uses in the Nugget and doc 19's own errata uses on the stage road.
